method: Stop-first within horizon using auto-adjusted OHLC from yfinance. Anchored at valid_for (the first trading day after signal_date), not signal_date itself, to avoid lookahead bias. For Mean Reversion, entry_px is the Open on valid_for (not the signal-date close that produced the RSI(2)/Bollinger trigger); other strategies use their published trigger/limit price. If Low <= stop at any point from valid_for..valid_for+h, exit=stop (R=-1). Else exit=Close[valid_for+h]. R=(exit-entry)/(entry-stop). Long-only R where stop < entry.
